quotes: _atomic_write: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST make the folder of path exist below base by calling _make_folders with folder_mode as its mode and durable_folder as its durable, creating only the folders of this address and nothing ahead of use, then write content to a fresh temporary file in that folder whose name is the imported TEMPORARY_NAME_PREFIX constant followed by an unpredictable name, created exclusively, without following a link and with the imported TEMPORARY_FILE_MODE constant, a name already taken being passed over for another; the temporary file MUST hold all of content with mode, be durable on storage and closed before it atomically replaces path, so an existing file at path is never absent to a reader. When durable_folder is true the folder of path MUST then be made durable with _sync_folder and any failure fails the write; when it is false that folder is made durable after the replacement and a failure there is neither raised nor undoes the file in place. A failure before the replacement MUST remove the temporary file, leave it when that removal fails too, and raise the original OSError; a temporary file a crash leaves stays and is never read. It opens with the flags os.O_CREAT, os.O_EXCL and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).

_make_folders: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST make every folder from base down to folder exist, outermost first, creating only the folders on that path below base: base itself is used as it stands, also through a link; a folder found, created by any call of any process and whatever its mode, is accepted as it stands, and a creation that loses the race to another process is accepted when the entry is then a folder; a folder this call creates MUST end with exactly mode, whatever the process umask; an entry on the path that is a symbolic link or not a folder, judged without following a link, MUST raise OSError. When durable is true, each folder this call creates MUST be made durable in its parent with _sync_folder before the next one is made. It removes nothing. It opens with the flags os.O_DIRECTORY and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).

_read_record: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST reach the record from the state folder, the third folder above path, opened as it stands, also through a link, through the two folders below it, each opened relative to the one before without following a link, and open the record file in the last of them for reading only, without blocking and without following a link; it MUST return None only when a folder on that path or the record file does not exist. A folder on the path that is a link or not a folder, a record that is a link or not a regular file, or a failed opening or reading MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns; otherwise it MUST return every byte of the record. Everything it opened is closed on every path and nothing is written. It opens with the flags os.O_DIRECTORY, os.O_NOFOLLOW and os.O_NONBLOCK, whose presence is never tested (A9).

project_lock: [BEHAVIOR] MUST be a context manager that holds the exclusive lock the operating system keeps per open file of the project's lock file, so another thread of the process waits as another process does, for the whole of the caller's block, waiting for another holder without a time limit and with no retry of its own, and releases and closes it on every exit. The lock file MUST be named by the canonical project id followed by the imported LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX constant in the folder of the imported LOCKS_FOLDER constant below the state_dir of context, which it makes exist with _make_folders, the imported STATE_FOLDER_MODE constant and durable false; it is created exclusively, without following a link, with the imported LOCK_FILE_MODE constant, or, when it exists, opened as it stands without following a link. Neither the lock file nor its folder is made durable, a lock found partly created is completed and nothing created is removed. It opens with the flags os.O_CREAT, os.O_EXCL and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).
